findings.title: UK Medical teams deliver lifeline healthcare in Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: Official £14 million allocation to UK-Med for Gaza healthcare this financial year. Expected to support 792,000 consultations through two field hospitals and 250 surgeries per month, plus reproductive health and rehabilitation services. Includes previously announced £1 million for Heal2Play; do not count that separately. Targets are projections, not delivered care or confirmation of supply access.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: £14 million allocation will support UK-Med’s frontline healthcare operations in Gaza
